name: How do I choose the right lighting for my kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right lighting for my kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right kitchen lighting involves considering a combination of ambient, task, and accent lighting. Ambient lighting provides overall illumination, while task lighting (like under-cabinet lights) brightens work surfaces. Accent lighting highlights features. Consider the kitchen's size, ceiling height, natural light, and your personal style. We can help you design a lighting plan that meets your needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider ambient, task, and accent lighting based on your kitchen's size, natural light, and style. We assist with lighting design.
